posts.text:
Iran's regime is so desperate for cash it's printing increasingly worthless rials just to avoid missing payroll for its security forces, government workers, and pensioners.

But printing money isn't the same as paying people when the currency has collapsed.

At 2.72 million rials to the dollar, the regime can print salaries. It can't print purchasing power.
posts.fa:
حکومت ایران آن‌قدر برای پول نقد درمانده است که ریال‌های هر روز بی‌ارزش‌تر چاپ می‌کند تا حقوق نیروهای امنیتی، کارمندان دولت و بازنشستگان عقب نیفتد.

اما وقتی پول ملی فروپاشیده، چاپ پول با پرداخت حقوق یکی نیست.

با دلار ۲.۷۲ میلیون ریالی، حکومت می‌تواند حقوق چاپ کند، ولی قدرت خرید نه.
posts.en:
Iran's regime is so desperate for cash it's printing increasingly worthless rials just to avoid missing payroll for its security forces, government workers, and pensioners.

But printing money isn't the same as paying people when the currency has collapsed.

At 2.72 million rials to the dollar, the regime can print salaries. It can't print purchasing power.

posts.text:
The Iranian regime can point fingers all it wants, but it cannot explain away its failure to cooperate with the UN's IAEA for inspections.

The world needs to hear this loud and clear: The United States and our partners will NEVER allow Iran to obtain a nuclear weapon. Period.
posts.fa:
حکومت ایران هر قدر بخواهد می‌تواند انگشت اتهام را به سوی دیگران بگیرد، اما نمی‌تواند همکاری نکردنش با آژانس بین‌المللی انرژی اتمی برای بازرسی‌ها را توجیه کند.

جهان باید این را بلند و روشن بشنود: آمریکا و شرکایش هرگز اجازه نمی‌دهند ایران به سلاح هسته‌ای دست یابد. والسلام.
posts.en:
The Iranian regime can point fingers all it wants, but it cannot explain away its failure to cooperate with the UN's IAEA for inspections.

The world needs to hear this loud and clear: The United States and our partners will NEVER allow Iran to obtain a nuclear weapon. Period.

posts.text:
Bombing electrical grids isn't going to get Iranians to overthrow the Islamic Republic. (Power outages didn't do it in Cuba.)

What committing war crimes will do is deprive Iranians of their ability to communicate, spoil food in fridges and markets, and make their lives even harder—everything from leaving the house to getting around the city.
posts.fa:
بمباران شبکه‌های برق ایرانیان را به سرنگونی جمهوری اسلامی وادار نمی‌کند. (خاموشی‌ها در کوبا هم چنین نکرد.)

کاری که ارتکاب جنایت جنگی می‌کند این است که ایرانیان را از امکان ارتباط محروم می‌کند، غذا را در یخچال‌ها و بازارها فاسد می‌کند و زندگی‌شان را سخت‌تر می‌کند؛ از بیرون رفتن از خانه گرفته تا رفت‌وآمد در شهر.
posts.en:
Bombing electrical grids isn't going to get Iranians to overthrow the Islamic Republic. (Power outages didn't do it in Cuba.)

What committing war crimes will do is deprive Iranians of their ability to communicate, spoil food in fridges and markets, and make their lives even harder—everything from leaving the house to getting around the city.

posts.text: Speaking on Thursday's episode of The Grand Standoff: Iran and the World, Professor Mohammad Marandi said he did not believe Iran takes Saudi Arabia's threats seriously. He argued that Saudi Arabia was incapable of confronting on the battlefield a country it had besieged for more than a decade, Yemen, meaning that any threats by Riyadh against Tehran will be taken lightly. Professor Marandi warned that if the United States launched an attack on Iran and sought to destroy its infrastructure, "Saudi Arabia is finished." He added that the same outcome would apply to other regional governments that assist Washington in its war on Iran.
posts.fa: محمد مرندی در برنامه‌ی پنجشنبه‌ی «رویارویی بزرگ: ایران و جهان» گفت فکر نمی‌کند ایران تهدیدهای عربستان را جدی بگیرد. به گفته‌ی او عربستان نمی‌تواند در میدان نبرد با کشوری روبه‌رو شود که بیش از یک دهه یمن را محاصره کرده، پس هر تهدید ریاض علیه تهران سبک گرفته می‌شود. مرندی هشدار داد اگر آمریکا به ایران حمله کند و بخواهد زیرساخت‌هایش را نابود کند، «کار عربستان تمام است» و همین درباره‌ی دیگر دولت‌های منطقه که به واشنگتن در جنگ با ایران کمک کنند هم صدق می‌کند.
posts.en: Speaking on Thursday's episode of The Grand Standoff: Iran and the World, Professor Mohammad Marandi said he did not believe Iran takes Saudi Arabia's threats seriously. He argued that Saudi Arabia was incapable of confronting on the battlefield a country it had besieged for more than a decade, Yemen, meaning that any threats by Riyadh against Tehran will be taken lightly. Professor Marandi warned that if the United States launched an attack on Iran and sought to destroy its infrastructure, "Saudi Arabia is finished." He added that the same outcome would apply to other regional governments that assist Washington in its war on Iran.

posts.text: Iran's IRGC Navy says a supertanker has struck a naval mine and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz. It claims the vessel is the third to "explode and catch fire today" after crossing what it described as an "unauthorised route."

posts.text: Qatar Calls for Stronger Maritime Security and Technology to Promote Global Peace. At a UN Security Council debate, Qatar's Permanent Representative Sheikha Alya Ahmed bin Saif Al-Thani reiterated Qatar's categorical rejection of using the Strait of Hormuz as a means of political pressure, calling for its unconditional reopening, and stressed that freedom of navigation and transit passage through this vital waterway are not subject to negotiation.
posts.fa: قطر خواستار تقویت امنیت دریایی شد. نماینده‌ی دائم قطر در سازمان ملل، شیخه علیا بنت سیف آل‌ثانی، در نشست شورای امنیت بار دیگر بر مخالفت قاطع قطر با استفاده از تنگه‌ی هرمز به‌عنوان ابزار فشار سیاسی تأکید کرد، خواستار بازگشایی بی‌قیدوشرط آن شد و گفت آزادی کشتیرانی و عبور از این آبراه حیاتی قابل مذاکره نیست.
posts.en: Qatar Calls for Stronger Maritime Security and Technology to Promote Global Peace. At a UN Security Council debate, Qatar's Permanent Representative Sheikha Alya Ahmed bin Saif Al-Thani reiterated Qatar's categorical rejection of using the Strait of Hormuz as a means of political pressure, calling for its unconditional reopening, and stressed that freedom of navigation and transit passage through this vital waterway are not subject to negotiation.

posts.text: NEW: President Trump reportedly received a high-level military briefing at the White House on potential U.S. military options involving Iran. @JacquiHeinrich reports the top U.S. commander in the Middle East met with Trump alongside Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Joint Chiefs Chairman Gen. Dan Caine. The meeting follows a similar briefing with Vice President JD Vance on Wednesday, as regional allies face warnings that U.S. strikes could resume after the midterm elections.
posts.fa: تازه: گزارش‌ها حاکی است ترامپ در کاخ سفید یک جلسه‌ی توجیهی نظامی سطح بالا درباره‌ی گزینه‌های احتمالی نظامی آمریکا در قبال ایران داشته است. به گزارش جکی هاینریش، فرمانده ارشد آمریکا در خاورمیانه همراه پیت هگست، وزیر دفاع، و ژنرال دن کین، رئیس ستاد مشترک، با ترامپ دیدار کرد. این جلسه پس از جلسه‌ی مشابهی با جی‌دی ونس در روز چهارشنبه برگزار شد، در حالی که به متحدان منطقه‌ای هشدار داده شده حملات آمریکا ممکن است پس از انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای از سر گرفته شود.
